summary: Lithium Argentina AG filed a Form 6-K announcing a strategic investment via a $180 million unsecured convertible note from Ganfeng Lithium, priced at $12.50 per share with a 4.0% coupon, a 96% premium to VWAP. Proceeds will repay $259 million convertible debt due January 2027, reducing dilution and extending maturities. The PPG joint venture consolidates projects, with Ganfeng 67%/Lithium Argentina 33%, requiring joint approval for key decisions. The conversion premium minimizes dilution, benefiting shareholders. Watch for conversion terms and debt repayment execution.
